name: careers-page
title: Careers page
description: The careers page template from library items: the page head in two tones and the openings with their department filter.
use_for: A careers page. Edit lib/pages/careers.ts or pass `content`; `sections` reorders or leaves sections out.
never: New colors, shadows, radii or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
People, clients or quotes you have no right to show: the defaults are Acme
A second plate button in a view
source: Built from the library's site items, after the site's components/careers-view.tsx, careers-section.tsx.

files.content:
import { footer, header } from '@/lib/pages/chrome'
// The careers page template's copy (components/careers-view.tsx, careers-section.tsx): the head and the openings.
// The roles are Acme's.
export const careersContent = {
	header,
	lead: 'Careers.',
	rest: 'A fully distributed studio of designers and engineers. Explore in code first, then polish in Figma.',
	roles: [
		{ title: 'Product designer', department: 'Design', href: '#' },
		{ title: 'Brand designer', department: 'Design', href: '#' },
		{ title: 'Design engineer', department: 'Engineering', href: '#' },
	],
	footer,
}
export type CareersContent = typeof careersContent
export const careersSections = ['head', 'openings'] as const
export type CareersSection = (typeof careersSections)[number]
